objective: A simpler admin menu: the first tab is a plain list of every animal and variant, a tap adds it to the admin's own ranch; the second tab only spawns each animal and plays their animations (no test waves, no enemies). A third tab, Enemies, does the same for every Hexbound enemy.
acceptance_criteria: The admin menu opens on Add animals: one row per animal and variant, with its picture, name and tier; a tap adds it to the admin's ranch
The Spawn tab has the animation buttons and Clear on top, then one Spawn button per animal and variant, and nothing else
The Enemies tab has the animation buttons and Clear on top, then one Spawn button per enemy in StationConfig.FOES
verification: Studio, local build, stamp `dev`: open the admin menu and check both tabs; Lune and selene clean.

The server keeps its actions (look, look_anim, look_clear, admin_add, testwave); only the menu changed.
